summary.text: John Fonfara, a Democrat, has represented District 1 in the Connecticut State Senate since 1997 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He previously served in the Connecticut House of Representatives, for District 4 from 1987 to 1993 and District 6 from 1993 to 1997.

He earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Connecticut in 1981 and an M.A. in public policy from Trinity College in 1991, and is an advertising consultant and vice president of marketing.
